title: Cervical PM
summary: Daily at bedtime. Releases the skull base and gently decompresses the neck after the day's loading. Stop if headache, dizziness or arm symptoms.

steps.name: Suboccipital Release
steps.cue: Lie on back, tennis balls or thumbs just under the skull base, either side of the spine. Let the head's weight rest on them; stay still and breathe. Stop if headache or dizziness.

steps.name: Gentle Neck Warm-Up
steps.cue: Slow, small nods, tilts and turns to prep for traction. Stay well short of end range, especially turning and looking up.

steps.name: Pettibon Traction — Door
steps.cue: Elbows and knees on door, curved piece behind neck, pad under chin. Exhale, sink toward ~20% body weight; inhale, stand. Start light; add ~5 reps a week up to 60. Stop if pain or arm symptoms.

steps.name: Cervical Traction — Supine
steps.cue: Lie on back, cup the base of the skull in both hands. Gently pull the head lengthwise away from the shoulders; no tilt or turn. Release very slowly. Stop if arm or hand symptoms rise.
